title: An older reader reads past what it does not know
situation: 0066: a runtime refuses any journal entry kind it does not know, so a journal holding one newer entry is unreadable to every older runtime, and a host, teammate or earlier branch's build cannot reconstitute. Event-sourced systems keep old readers working with a tolerant reader.
decision: A runtime that meets an entry of a kind it does not know reads past it, computes everything else as usual, and reports with every view that the journal holds entries it cannot interpret, naming their kinds and how many, so its views may be incomplete; it never refuses the whole journal, and it may still append, since entries are independent. An entry of a known kind that it cannot read is still refused, naming the entry.
consequences: Realized in the delivery cut (0108), alongside version skew, which tells the operator to install again.
